evidence.quote: For a verified damaged-item claim, support may approve a replacement or a direct-sale refund within 14 calendar days of delivery.

Standard-plan customers may request a refund within 14 calendar days of delivery. The item must be unused and the order reference must be available. The delivery event, rather than the date of the first support contact, starts the window.

answer_parts.text: For a verified damaged-item claim on direct-sale physical goods, support may approve a replacement or a direct-sale refund within 14 calendar days of delivery. The applicable return rule for standard-plan customers is also to request a refund within 14 calendar days from the date of delivery.
